$Comment: A Pumpkin Fiend Hatchling on the Headless Horseman's hard ride: Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling written out again, as the game writes its own hard bosses, with more health, MaxHealth 130 against 60, the same step up as his own hard health (2376 against 1100). The hard ride's FightWaves raise it in place of the normal Hatchling. Everything else is that file's: the look (Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend), the nameplate, the drop list and the 6 damage hit, and FlockArray names this role's own id. Like every season creature here it is a Variant of the vanilla template carrying the vanilla creature's Modify, so this Modify is the wild fiend's and the normal Hatchling's word for word except MaxHealth and FlockArray: change the three together (Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend.json says how it is built). It has an id of its own so that only the fight's fiends are in Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Adds_Group, which his fight waits on and clears when it resets. It never spawns in the wild. A kill pays Hallowed favor (it is in Hallows_Eve_Event_Mobs), counts for Old Jack's fiend jobs, and pays MMO Skill Tree's kill XP from its own row in Mmo_Hallows_Eve.json.
